programme.desc: Abu Gabal and his family live a life that puts a lot of stress on him. As a reaction to all the uncomfortable circumstances in which he lives with his family, he starts losing control over himself and this is when life becomes so much tougher for him.

programme.title: Shams El Aseel
programme.desc: A family returns from traveling after many years, carrying a baby girl that everyone thinks is their daughter, before days reveal the completely different truth. Then the head of the family appears, who rejects the idea of ​​adoption despite his wife's insistence.

programme.title: Al Qafer
programme.desc: Set 150 years ago in an Omani neighborhood, the series follows a man with the extraordinary ability to hear underground water.
